decisions.why: confirmed on the supplier's own site (purplesurgical.com), a dedicated 'Sharps Safe Management' range of intra-operative sharps-safety devices (Sharps Safety Station, Puncture Proof Pad, Purple Turtle, magnetic retrieval). Distinct from infection:sharps (disposal containers, not intra-op safety) and theatres:theatre (no safety theme). New type theatres:sharps added this batch.
